Wave Maps is a wave atlas website that I designed & developed in collaboration with developer Eva Virseda. The site provides detailed information about surf spots, including interactive maps and wave characteristics. The goal of the project was to create a website that offered practical information about waves while also being visually appealing and easy to navigate.
Wave Maps Asia view on iPhone

One of the main challenges of this project was to create a design that could effectively present complex information about waves and surf spots in a way that was both visually appealing and easy to understand.
Wave Maps America view on iPad

The design of the website is clean and modern, with a focus on high-quality visuals and easy navigation. The use of interactive maps allows users to explore different surf spots and learn about their wave characteristics in an engaging way.
